name: Test: C# hook entry cost
author: test
summary: Cost of entering a C# On_ hook from the game: isolated, right after and in a burst, with 1 and 3 hooks and with the hooks removed. Frame times, managed allocations and Mono GCs per window.
description: Build with tools/tests/build-cs.sh csperf. Needs the profiler: adb shell setprop debug.bl.cshookprofile 1 before launching. Run with jsentry and QJS=true to compare with JS in the same run. Logs csperf ... and csperf END.
